parser.test_split: parsed only after this manifest is committed

last_token: a whole alphabetic word that ends its spaCy token (or a possessive 's), at position >= 111

pobj.label: grammar: fires on the object of a preposition ('in the house' at 'house'), not on the same word in another grammatical role

prep.label: grammar: fires on a preposition linking two content words ('the edge of the table' at 'of'), not on the same word in another grammatical role

verb_dobj.label: grammar: fires on a verb that takes a direct object ('she wrote a letter' at 'wrote'), not on the same word in another grammatical role

nsubj.label: grammar: fires on the subject of a clause, not on the same word in another grammatical role

dobj.label: grammar: fires on the direct object of a verb ('she wrote a letter' at 'letter'), not on the same word in another grammatical role

intensified.label: grammar: fires on an adjective or adverb modified by an intensifier before it ('very old' at 'old'), not on the same word in another grammatical role

amod.label: grammar: fires on an adjective modifying a noun ('an old book' at 'old'), not on the same word in another grammatical role

amod_head.label: grammar: fires on a noun modified by an adjective before it ('an old book' at 'book'), not on the same word in another grammatical role

advmod_verb.label: grammar: fires on an adverb modifying a verb, not an adjective or adverb ('ran quickly', not 'quickly forgotten fact'), not on the same word in another grammatical role

det_noun.label: grammar: fires on a noun headed by a determiner ('the book' at 'book'), not on the same word in another grammatical role

poss.label: grammar: fires on a possessor ('her book', 'John's book' at 'her', 'John'), not on the same word in another grammatical role

poss_s.label: grammar: fires on the possessive 's ('John's book' at ''s'), not the contraction of is or has, not on the same word in another grammatical role

conj2.label: grammar: fires on the second conjunct of 'X and Y' or 'X or Y' (at 'Y'), not on the same word in another grammatical role

aux_verb.label: grammar: fires on a verb with an auxiliary before it ('has eaten', 'will go' at the verb), not on the same word in another grammatical role

negated.label: grammar: fires on a verb negated by a 'not' or 'never' before it ('did not go' at 'go'), not on the same word in another grammatical role

than.label: grammar: fires on the compared term after 'than' ('bigger than a house' at 'house'), not on the same word in another grammatical role

relcl_start.label: grammar: fires on a relative pronoun opening a relative clause ('the book which' at 'which'), not on the same word in another grammatical role

particle.label: grammar: fires on the particle of a phrasal verb ('give up' at 'up'), not on the same word in another grammatical role

passive.label: grammar: fires on a passive participle ('was taken' at 'taken'), not a perfect ('has taken'), not on the same word in another grammatical role

wh_question.label: grammar: fires on a question word in a direct question ('Where did' in a sentence ending with '?'), not on the same word in another grammatical role

pos:pobj.label: grammar (any word): fires on the object of a preposition ('in the house' at 'house'), whatever the word, not on words of the same part of speech in other roles

pos:nsubj.label: grammar (any word): fires on the subject of a clause, whatever the word, not on words of the same part of speech in other roles

pos:dobj.label: grammar (any word): fires on the direct object of a verb ('she wrote a letter' at 'letter'), whatever the word, not on words of the same part of speech in other roles

pos:poss.label: grammar (any word): fires on a possessor ('her book', 'John's book' at 'her', 'John'), whatever the word, not on words of the same part of speech in other roles

pos:amod_head.label: grammar (any word): fires on a noun modified by an adjective before it ('an old book' at 'book'), whatever the word, not on words of the same part of speech in other roles

pos:det_noun.label: grammar (any word): fires on a noun headed by a determiner ('the book' at 'book'), whatever the word, not on words of the same part of speech in other roles

pos:conj2.label: grammar (any word): fires on the second conjunct of 'X and Y' or 'X or Y' (at 'Y'), whatever the word, not on words of the same part of speech in other roles

pos:aux_verb.label: grammar (any word): fires on a verb with an auxiliary before it ('has eaten', 'will go' at the verb), whatever the word, not on words of the same part of speech in other roles

pos:negated.label: grammar (any word): fires on a verb negated by a 'not' or 'never' before it ('did not go' at 'go'), whatever the word, not on words of the same part of speech in other roles

pos:verb_dobj.label: grammar (any word): fires on a verb that takes a direct object ('she wrote a letter' at 'wrote'), whatever the word, not on words of the same part of speech in other roles

pos:intensified.label: grammar (any word): fires on an adjective or adverb modified by an intensifier before it ('very old' at 'old'), whatever the word, not on words of the same part of speech in other roles

pos:amod.label: grammar (any word): fires on an adjective modifying a noun ('an old book' at 'old'), whatever the word, not on words of the same part of speech in other roles

pos:advmod_verb.label: grammar (any word): fires on an adverb modifying a verb, not an adjective or adverb ('ran quickly', not 'quickly forgotten fact'), whatever the word, not on words of the same part of speech in other roles

pos:than.label: grammar (any word): fires on the compared term after 'than' ('bigger than a house' at 'house'), whatever the word, not on words of the same part of speech in other roles

separating_diagnostic: poles with selection AUROC >= 0.85 at any magnitude (not a selection)
read: last token, mean over the 3 PREAMBLES (selection: PREAMBLES[0])
placebo: per condition: selection on quiet-vs-quiet pairs (false selections) and an 8 + 8 quiet-vs-quiet test on the selected poles (false holds)
report: held / failed / placebo by construction, by layer band, and by the pole's atlas bin (auto-token@2 word screen); coverage of held conditions: the share of the pole's 32 strongest corpus activations (scan, English windows) where the condition holds, against the condition's base rate
